decisions.statement: Every stoplight the three tiles draw is drawn here at once.
The lock screen keeps the groups apart, a row to each.
The island draws the thirteen in one run, since a group name costs width.
A gap wider than the one between rings is where a group ends and the next opens.
The one mark a compact island has room for is the worst color reached.
The figure beside it is how many stoplights are short of green.
Nothing here asks the server for a reading.
The activity's background is tinted clear rather than left to the system material.
What sits behind the rings is whatever the lock screen already draws there.
What the lock screen shows is what was last handed to the activity.

definition: all thirteen stoplights drawn as one live activity
